verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop processor, a hardware component that is not something a user operates through commands, so a natural-language control interface is a category error for this kind of product. The GAIA framework and Lemonade SDK are developer tools for building and running local LLM agents on the chip. They do not let a user operate the processor itself through natural language, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
